name: Sanction (Su)
category: Rogue Genius Games – Slayer Advanced Talents
body:
Prerequisite(s): Advanced talents

Benefit(s): Any creature killed by the slayer is treated as having been killed by a death effect for purposes of what magic can be used to restore the creature to life.

Advanced Options: Slayer Talents & Lethalities ©2014, Rogue Genius Games. Author: Owen K.C. Stephens.
